title: Winter Is Coming — the lions come to Winterfell

beats.setting: the Winterfell feast hall the night the royal court arrives
beats.stakes: King Robert means to name Eddard Stark his Hand. Cersei watches the Starks and weighs how far northern honor can be bent before it breaks.

beats.setting: a shadowed alcove off the Winterfell guest wing, away from the feast
beats.stakes: With the old Hand dead and a new one rising, Littlefinger feels out the queen: each offers the other use, and each means to keep the upper hand.

beats.setting: the lord's solar at Winterfell, the morning after the feast
beats.stakes: Before the court rides south, the powers in the room test one another: who will hold the king's ear, who his gold, and who his trust.
